offerings.name: Search
offerings.pricing: Hobby: $19/month billed monthly, or $16/month billed annually, for 5,000 credits per month (2,500 searches). Pay-as-you-go: 1,000 extra credits per $5 on Hobby.
offerings.free_quota: 1,000 credits / month; 500 searches or 1,000 pages scraped.
offerings.output_type: 结构化搜索结果；返回 titles、descriptions、URLs，并可选返回每个结果的 markdown、HTML、links 或 screenshots。
offerings.note: Search costs 2 credits per 10 results，按 10 个结果向上取整；支持 web、news、images。
